why: Both land on the key's hedgehog (lowest-cost western bank, profit per employee) and its brutal facts, but Analysis 2 adds cutting executive perks starting at the top and invents fewer numeric thresholds, though it is softer on exiting existing overseas offices. Analysis 1 has the crisper verdict and its single-metric gaming warning is closer to the later sales-pressure scandal, but Analysis 2 is the slightly more useful document for the incoming CEO.
